name: aurelglyph
description: A token-first UX design language and component system for SwiftUI, React, React Native, and Rails.

scripts.build: npm run build:assets && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:pages: npm run build:tokens && tsx --tsconfig tsconfig.base.json scripts/pages.ts
scripts.security:ruby: ruby scripts/ruby-runtime-check.rb && bundle exec bundler-audit check --update
scripts.test:react-native-host: npm test -w @aurelglyph/example-react-native-smoke && npm run test:android -w @aurelglyph/example-react-native-smoke && npm run test:ios -w @aurelglyph/example-react-native-smoke
scripts.test:swift-host: npm run build:ios -w @aurelglyph/example-swiftui-smoke && npm run test:ios -w @aurelglyph/example-swiftui-smoke
scripts.verify: npm run version:check && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build:pages && npm run test:unit && npm run test:rails && npm run test:swift && npm run test:swift-host && npm run test:react-native-host && npm run typecheck && npm run test:ux && npm run test:browsers && npm run security:check && npm run security:ruby && npm run pack:check && npm run pack:gem
scripts.verify:release: npm run version:release-check && npm run verify
